description: This file defines the IAsyncObserver interface within the Orleans.Streams namespace. The interface generalizes the .NET IObserver interface to support asynchronous item processing, including methods for handling new items, stream completion, and errors.

classes.name: IAsyncObserver<in T>
classes.description: An interface for asynchronous observation of stream data, allowing consumers to process items asynchronously, with support for stream completion and error notification.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles the receipt of a new item asynchronously, returning a Task that completes when the item has been accepted by the consumer.

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles the notification that the stream has completed; returns a Task that completes when the consumer has accepted the stream’s completion.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles an error occurred on the stream asynchronously, returning a Task that completes when the consumer has accepted the error notification.
